monument_title: 17th-Century Carpathian-Galician Manuscript Octoechos (Октоїх рукописний, Прикарпаття, XVII ст.)

primary_bottlenecks: Duplicate physical photographic exposure between Page_0164.jpg and Page_0165.jpg (both showing spread of fols. 159v-160r): subagent executed 20+ shell commands (Get-FileHash, PIL ImageChops, inspecting SPARSE_EXEMPT_KEYWORDS in run_small_pause_gate.py) to verify how to record p165 without triggering SGC-02 ratio failure or duplicating liturgical text.
High weekday script density (3,073 Slavonic words -> 4,703 English words across 9 unique openings).

Physical paper repair patch pasted over the upper margin and headpiece of p109 (fol. 103r, # TONE 7): subagent executed 12 PIL cropping and cross-monument concordance commands (searching 1629_kyiv_octoechos and 1895_lviv_octoechos) to reconstruct the obscured lines.
Windows CP1252 UnicodeEncodeError during ad-hoc python -c Cyrillic searches.
Highest English word count in the codex (5,076 English words from 3,092 Slavonic words across dense Weekday Canons).
Subagent spent 7 shell commands querying codex_registry.json and liturgical_primitives_registry.json (hitting CP1252 UnicodeEncodeError twice).
Gate 1B (lint_liturgical_slop.py) failed on 4 occurrences of 'wherefore'/'Hearken' (lines 229, 343, 349, 400), requiring 4 sequential edit_file calls and re-audits.

dimension_1_cohort_velocity.cross_cohort_report_overwrite_anomaly: Subagents for Cohort 17 (step 78) and Cohort 21 (step 71) ran run_small_pause_gate.py on the previous cohort (--cohort 16 and --cohort 20), overwriting cohort16_small_pause_report.json (+514s) and cohort20_small_pause_report.json (+775s) mtimes after promotion.

phase1_subagent_caught_anomalies.details: Replaced forbidden '*Resurrection Apolytikion, Tone 2:*' with '*Resurrection Troparion, Tone 2:*' (L190).
False positive on apostrophe to Christ's Tomb ('may worship thee, O Life-Giving Tomb; for Christ, truly our God...'). Subagent capitalized 'Thee' (L305).

Replaced 'becometh' -> 'befits' (L43); Gate 2 false positive on 'him' referring to the serpent near 'Almighty Lord' ('crushing him' -> 'crushing the adversary', L80); Gate 2 false positive on 'thee/thy' referring to the Theotokos near 'Mother of the Most High God' (reordered to 'Mother of God, the Most High', L281).
False positive on 'thou/thine' referring to the Theotokos near 'O Birthgiver of God'. Subagent hyphenated 'Birth-giver of God' to evade proximity trigger (L111).
False positive on 'him' referring to the demonic enemy near 'O Lord' ('hoping in Thee, O Lord, I vanquish him!' -> 'I vanquish the enemy!', L108).
Caught 'maketh' (L204) and 'taketh' (L240, L274), plus subagent edited 'granteth' (L240), but linter missed 6 occurrences of 'heareth'/'rejecteth' on L215.
Caught 'wherefore'/'Wherefore' (L229, L343, L400) and 'Hearken' in Ps. 44:11 (L349); replaced with 'therefore' and 'Give ear'.

phase2_compiler_self_healed_anomalies.root_cause: scripts/lint_liturgical_slop.py (Gate 1B) checks only 13 hardcoded -eth verbs (singeth, proclaimeth, censeth, entereth, maketh, readeth, beginneth, taketh, vesteth, boweth, kisseth, turneth, standeth), whereas compile_final_edition.py (heal_cohort_and_apparatus_text) and verify_publication_edition.py (Gate 4) enforce universal \b[A-Za-z]+eth\b normalization.

false_negative_cruxes_missed_by_queue.reason: Pasted paper repair patch obscuring top lines of # TONE 7 headpiece; subagent wrote '[...]' and 'paper repair patch' in footnote, which did not match literal '[?]'/'[lacuna]'/'[damaged]'/'[illegible]' in run_small_pause_gate.py.
Duplicate photographic exposure of Page_0164.jpg (fols. 159v-160r); bilingual codicological note had ratio 0.870, staying inside [0.50, 2.20].

dimension_4_compiler_and_monument_edge_c.issue: When _is_scaffolded_pub_spec is True (universal_dynamic_h1 mode), dynamically sliced parts in self.pub_spec['parts'] were not persisted back to codex_registry.json, causing verify_publication_edition.py to fail with 'has no publication_spec in codex_registry.json!'.

Stitched 0 out of 209 mid-sentence leaf boundaries because RE_LEAF_BANNER ('=== LEAF pN ===') does not set pending_milestone = locus.get_milestone(), and top-of-page manuscript running headers ('[Sunday.]', '(fol. N)') are not recognized by RE_PAGE_HEADER, consuming the boundary before the '...continuation' line.

Assigned 'office': 'Front Matter' and 'ode': null to 100% of all 3,125 items, and assigned 'tone': 8 to 1,425 items (absorbing Cohorts 15-22 weekday Tones 1-7 and Exapostilaria), because generate_propers_corpus relies on explicit H2/H4 headings whereas manuscript cohorts use inline italic rubrics.
Hardcoded len(grid_tones) < 8 failed on a 222-leaf manuscript Octoechos that physically attests explicit Podoben rubrics in 5 tones ([1, 3, 4, 6, 8], 20 invocations).

Gate 7F parity mismatch (comp=20, grid=20, rev=19) because generate_father_paul_digest counted raw 'podoben:' lines in Cohorts/*.md on disk (19) instead of normalized all_stitched_cohorts in memory (20, after PODOBEN_SAME_NORMALIZED expanded C12:p112).

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Enable Leaf-Banner & Running-Header Seam Stitching for Epigraphic Manuscripts
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Stitches all 209 severed mid-sentence leaf seams in manuscript codices where [Left Page]/[Column A] scaffolding is absent and running headers ([Sunday.], (fol. N)) appear at leaf tops.

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Unify Propers Corpus State Machine with Inline Italic Rubrics (Office, Ode, & Weekday Tone Tracking)
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Eliminates 100% 'office': 'Front Matter' (3,125/3,125), 'ode': null (3,125/3,125), and Tone 8 weekday absorption (1,425 items) in _propers_corpus.json.

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Unify Gate 1B (lint_liturgical_slop.py) 3rd-Person -eth Detection with Gate 4 & Pre-Gate Self-Healer
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Catches and deterministically heals 100% of 3rd-person -eth verbs (31 occurrences across 10 cohorts) and 'wherefore'/'hearken' at Gate 1B without subagent edit round-trips.

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Add Marian (Theotokion) & Adversary Clauses to Hieratic Pronoun Auditor Exclusion Filter
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Eliminates 100% of Gate 2 false positives on lowercase pronouns referring to the Theotokos, the Life-Giving Tomb, or Satan/the enemy in clauses containing divine titles (6 false positives across 4 cohorts).

dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.title: Inject Inline Pre-Flight Summary & Lock --cohort Target in Work Order Template to Eliminate Exploratory Shell Overhead
dimension_6_top_5_recommendations.impact: Eliminates 15-35 exploratory shell commands per cohort (saving ~5-8 minutes per cohort on registry lookups, CP1252 crashes, and accidental re-runs on cohort K-1).
